name: Workflow File Node
description: On-demand Agent guide for inspecting File nodes through typed backend actions only.

controlSurface.storage: Harness/a2a/component-nodes/**/state.json is backend-owned diagnostic storage, never an Agent control surface.
controlSurface.contentRoute: Use backend file/meta/text routes exposed by the File node adapter; do not infer absolute filesystem paths from state files.

excel.readXlsx: List the sheet names of the bound .xlsx workbook: {sheets: [names]}.
excel.readXlsxSheet: Read one sheet paged: {sheet, page, pageSize}. sheet accepts a sheet name or a 1-based index and defaults to the first sheet. Returns headers plus the requested page of data rows; rows are bounded by pageSize and totalPages is included, so a workbook is never returned whole.
excel.errors: Corrupt or unreadable .xlsx files fail with a machine-readable error (code XLSX_PARSE, status 400).

pdf.readPdf: Return the bound PDF's total page count and document metadata: {totalPages, metadata: {title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, ...}}.
pdf.readPdfPage: Extract a page range as text: {page, pageCount}. Text is returned with the isEvalSupported:false security baseline — no JavaScript evaluation is ever enabled during rendering.
pdf.errors: Corrupt or unreadable PDF files fail with a clear machine-readable error (code PDF_PARSE, status 400).

zip.readZipEntries: List archive entries: {name, size, compressedSize, directory, isUtf8}. The archive is walked lazily — never read whole into memory; GBK-encoded legacy file names are decoded automatically.
zip.readZipEntry: Preview a single text entry: {entryName, maxBytes?}. The preview is bounded by maxBytes (default 65536) and flagged truncated when capped. Only text-like extensions are allowed (.txt/.md/.json/.js/.ts/.css/.html/.csv/.log/.yaml/.yml); binary entries are refused with ZIP_ENTRY_NOT_TEXT.
zip.extractZipEntry: Extract a single entry into a workspace-controlled destDir: {entryName, destDir?}. destDir defaults to Harness/a2a/file-extracts/<nodeId>/ and must stay inside the workspace. Entry names with ../ or ..\ segments or absolute paths are rejected (ZIP_SLIP), so nothing can escape the archive or the workspace.

locks.acquireLock: Acquire (or renew) a write lease on the file node: {holder, ttlMs?, lockId?}. The lease is persisted in backend-owned state (survives restarts), expires after the TTL, and stale leases are reclaimed automatically. While a foreign lease is live, file.writeText refuses with 409 file_locked carrying holder and expiresAt.
locks.releaseLock: Release the lease; only the holder may release: {holder, lockId?}. Missing or already-expired leases are a no-op (released: false).

prohibitions: Never edit `Harness/a2a/**/state.json` directly — use typed actions.
Never edit component-node state files or the workflow map file.
Never infer absolute filesystem paths from state files; use the backend file routes only.
Never put secret or credential payloads in node actions; action payloads may be recorded.
Never pass extraction destDir values that escape the workspace; file.extractZipEntry rejects them.
